SILPACHEEP — Rebranding identity

Overview

SILPACHEEP is a Thai arts and crafts initiative established under the royal initiative of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, the Queen Mother, to preserve traditional craftsmanship and create sustainable livelihoods for local artisans. Developed as part of the 6th National Youth Design Awards (NYDA), this rebranding project aims to reinterpret SILPACHEEP’s visual identity through three key concepts Artistic Contemporary and Valuable, connecting Thailand’s cultural heritage with modern audiences and bringing Thai craftsmanship to an international stage.

Logo design

The logo concept draws inspiration from the essence of SILPACHEEP, where traditional craftsmanship becomes a foundation for sustainable livelihoods. Through three core principles Elegance, Stability, and Connection the design translates the initiative’s values into a contemporary typographic identity, balancing the delicacy of craftsmanship with the strength of community empowerment.

  • 01 Elegance (ความอ่อนช้อย): Gracefully softened corners are incorporated into the letterforms to reflect the elegance and refinement of traditional Thai craftsmanship, bringing a subtle sense of delicacy to the visual identity.
  • 02 Stability (รากฐานที่มั่นคง): The solid bases of the letterforms symbolize SILPACHEEP’s role in establishing strong foundations for local artisans, supporting stable careers and sustainable livelihoods.
  • 03 Connection (การเชื่อมโยงอาชีพ): The visual connection between “Silpa” (Art) and “Cheep” (Livelihood) represents the relationship between artistic craftsmanship and career opportunities, reflecting SILPACHEEP’s mission to transform traditional skills into sustainable livelihoods.

Colour palette

Artisan Sky, Indigo Vat, Gilding Red and Brocade Gold. The brand's color palette draws inspiration from Thai cultural heritage and traditional craftsmanship. Each color reflects elegance, artistry, and cultural value, creating a contemporary identity that honors Thai traditions while appealing to an international audience.

Visual identity and applications

A flexible and adaptable layout system was developed to maintain visual consistency across various communication platforms. The system allows design elements to be easily rearranged and applied to different formats, particularly social media content, while preserving the brand’s visual identity.
